त: tá [495], pron. he, she, it, they; that, those; both subst. and adj., 115, 38, 9; 	—1. correl. of ya, which usually precedes [512], 314, 918, 105, 225, 2915, 3210, 7016, 7713; but sa …ya, 1722, 3316, 739; otiose, 1820, 2014; 	—2. in connection w. a pron. of the 1st or 2d pers.: e. g. táṃ tvā…īmahe, thee, who art such a one (as aforesaid), we beseech, i. e. therefore we beseech thee, 7613; cf. 829; tébhyo nas…brūhi, to us, who are these (unsuccessful ones--just described), tell thou, i. e. do thou tell us then, 9613; similarly, w. a verb in the 1st or 2d pers., whose subject is not expressed, 6917, 732, 7612, 17, 831, 9513, 994, 1004; 	—3. w. other pronouns: tasya…etasya, of thís, 956; yat tad…tad, what (was) that…, that, 577; ya ta, whoever, anybody, 184; ya ya…ta ta, whoever…that, 1312; cf. 4513; 	—4. attenuated in mg (like the Greek ὁ) to a simple article: te devās, the gods, 9214; sa bhīmas, Bhīma, 115. [w. sa, sā, tad, cf. ὁ, ἡ, τό, Goth. sa, so, ϸata, AS. se, seō, ðœt, ‘he, she, it,’ Eng. that; cf. also Lat. is-tud, ‘that.’]
तक्ष्: √takṣ (tákṣati; tatákṣa, tatakṣé; átakṣīt; taṣṭá; -tákṣya). hew; work (wood); make (of wood or other material); fashion. [cf. tákṣ-an and τέκτ-ων, ‘carpenter’; ἔ-τεκ-ον, ‘produced’; Lat. tignum, ‘log’: cf. √tvakṣ and toka.]
तड्: √taḍ (tāḍáyati; tāḍayā́m āsa; tāḍitá; -tā́ḍya). beat. + pari, strike; pelt.
तत: tatá, m. father. [cf. τέττα, Lat. tata, ‘papa’: Eng. dad, though of similar make, has of course no direct connection.]
ततस्: tátas, adv. 	—1. (as abl. of pron. root ta [1098], and synonymous w. tasmāt) out of it, 3613; 	—2. from that (place), from there, 10315; thence; there; itas tatas, here and there, hither and thither, 2511, 2915, 17; 	—3. from that (time), thereupon, 222; then, very often, e. g. 1111, 2011, 5617; correl. w. yad, 9213; w. yadā, 379; w. ced, 525; tataḥ, prabhṛti, from then on, 47, 3217; 	—4. therefore; 	—5. otiose, 4711; 52, 11, 1116; then, w. otiose tadā, 31, 48. [pron. root ta, 497, 1098.]
तत्क्षण: tat-kṣaṇa, m. that moment; -am, adv. in that moment, straightway. [tad.]
तत्त्व: tattva, n. (that-ness, i. e.) essence, real condition or state of a thing. [tad.]
तत्त्वज्ञ: tattva-jña, a. knowing the essence or the truth or what's what.
तत्पर: tat-para, a. having that as highest object;  given over to, intent upon. [tad.]
तत्र: tátra, adv. 	—1. (as synonymous w. loc. of tad in all numbers and genders) in or among or on this or these or them, 137, 218, 3811, 5722; in this matter, 378; herein, 982; 	—2. there, often, e. g. 28, 56; thither, 66, 1114, etc.; correl. w. yatra, 244; 	—3. on that occasion, in that case, then, 41, 1422, 401. [pron. root ta, 497, 1099.]
तत्समीपे: tat-samīpe, adv. near him. [tad: see samīpa.]
तथा: táthā, adv. 	—1. so, thus, 114, 2416; in this way, 9920; w. yathā, yathā regularly preceding: yathā…tathā: as…so, 2116, 616, 7713; in order that…thus, 3016, 377; but tathā…yathā, so…as, 2213, 4320; yathā yathā…tathā tathā, to what degree…to that degree, the more… the more, 4814; yathā tathā, in one way or another, 629; 	—2. particle of assent, so be it, yes, 42, 86, 4812, 945; that is so, 5216; 	—3. so, in like manner, 198; or, simply conjunctive, also, likewise, 108, 1213, etc.; tathā_eva, just so (cf. Middle Eng. al so, i. e.), likewise, also, 111, 710; tathā ca, 1820, see ca 3; 	—4. tathā_api, so even, even under those circumstances, nevertheless, 2111. [pron. root ta, 497, 1101.]
तथाविध: táthā-vidha, a. of such sort, in such condition. [tathā (1306) + vidhā, 1302c 5.]
तद्: tád, 	—1. as nom. acc. s. n. to ta, see ta; used also in cpds and derivatives, see 497; 	—2. as adv. there; yatra…tad, where…there, 10318; 	—3. then, in that case, 2717, 365; ced…tad, if…then, 375; so yadi…tad, 3712; tad…yad, then…when, 712; simply continuative: tat ko vṛtras, who then is V., 9719; so 242; 	—4. in this way, i. e. therefore, accordingly, 188, 1913, 22, 2714, etc.; yad…tad, since…therefore, 176; so yatas…tad, 377. [cf. 495.]
तदनन्तर: tad-anantara, a. immediately adjoining that; -am, adv. [1311], immediately after that; thereupon.
तदभिमुख: tad-abhimukha, a. turned towards him; -am, adv. [1311], towards him.
तदर्धिक: tad-ardhika, a. amounting to or lasting half of that.
तदा: tadā́, adv. at that time; then, 220; in that case; often otiose in Epos, 37; so after tatas, 31, 49; yadā…tadā, when…then, 2617; yadā yadā…tadā tadā, whensoever…then,  3111; yadi…tadā, if…then, 259. [pron. root ta, 497, 1103.]
तदाकृति: tad-ākṛti, a. having the appearance of them (i. e. of Piśāchas).
तदाहारवर्त्मन्: tadāhāra-vartman, n. the way of that food. [tad-āhāra.]
तदीप्सित: tad-īpsita, a. desired by those two.
तदीय: tadīya, a. pertaining to him, her, it, or them; such. [tad, 497.]
तद्भय: tad-bhaya, m. fear of it or them.
तद्रस: tad-rasa, m. the essence of it.
तद्वत्: tad-vat, adv. in this way, so; likewise. [tad: 1107.]
तद्विद्: tad-víd, a. knowing that; as m. connoisseur or judge.
तद्वृद्धि: tad-vṛddhi, f. the interest of them.
तन्: √1tan (tanóti, tanuté; tatā́na, tené [794e]; átānīt; taṃsyáte; tatá; tántum; tatvā́; -tátya; tāyáte [772]). 	—1. stretch, trans. and intrans.; extend, reach; spread over; 	—2. continue, endure, 7913; 	—3. stretch (a weft or a line); continue (the line of a family); 	—4. metaphorically, of sacrifice and supplication (which are compared with a weft), perform, make. [cf. τάνυμαι, ‘stretch’; Lat. tenēre, ‘hold,’ tendere, ‘stretch’; AS. ϸenian, Ger. dehnen, ‘stretch’: see also tanu.] + ā, spread over; overspread (esp. with light), beshine; stretch (a bow). + pari, stretch around; surround; envelope. + vi, stretch out; spread out, cover; vitata, stretched, hung, dependent, 9211. + sam, hold together, intrans.; bind together;  make continuous; saṃtata, (just like Lat. con-tinens) uninterrupted.

√2tan (tányati). resound. [cf. τόνος, ‘tone’; Lat. tonare, ‘thunder’; AS. noun ϸunor, ‘thunder,’ whence denom. verb ϸunrian, Eng. thunder; AS. ϸunres dœg, Eng. Thurs-day, ‘day sacred to the Old Germanic god of the thunder-storm, ϸonar or Thor’: see tanyatú, ‘thunder.’]
तनु: tanú, f. [3442] tanu, tanū́, tanvī, a. thin, tenuis, slender; --tanu or tanū́ [decl. 356], as subst. f. body, 563, 8918; person; one's own person, self, used like ātman [514] as reflexive pron., 7312, 7812; outward form or manifestation, 8411. [prop. ‘stretched out, thin,’ √1tan: cf. τανυ-, ‘extended, long,’ in cpds; Lat. tenuis, Eng. thin, Ger. dünn, ‘thin.’]
तनुमध्य: tanu-madhya, a. having a slender middle,  i. e. slender-waisted.
तनूत्यज्: tanū-tyáj, a. abandoning the body, risking life, brave.
तन्ति: tantí, f. cord; esp. a long line to which calves are tethered by means of short ropes; tantī, the same. [√1tan.]
तन्तु: tántu, m. thread, 891; metaphorically, of the thread, i. e. course, of a sacrifice. [√1tan.]
तन्त्र: tántra, n. thread; warp of a web; fig. fundamental doctrine; division of a work. [√1tan.]
तन्द्रित: tandrita, a. wearied, only w. a-. [tandrā, 1176b.]
तप्: √tap (tápati, -te; tatā́pa, tepé [794e]; átāpsīt; tapsyáti; taptá; táptum; taptvā́; -tápya; tapyáte, tápyate [761b]). 	—1. be warm; burn, intrans.; 	—2. heat; make glowing; burn, trans.; 	—3. fig. (like √śuc), distress, pain; 	—4. pass. suffer; suffer voluntarily, castigate one's self, do penance. [cf. Lat. tepēre, AS. ϸefian, ‘be warm.’] + upa, heat; become sick; sicken, used impers., w. acc. of the person, 1013. + sam, heat; pain.
तपस्: tápas, n. 	—1. heat, fire; 	—2. voluntary suffering (see tap 3, 4), self-castigation, self-torture (6421), mortification, asceticism,  devotion. [√tap.]
तपस्वत्: tápasvant, a. full of devotion; pious. [1233a.]
तपस्वन्त्: tápasvant, a. full of devotion; pious. [1233a.]
तपोज: tapo-já, a. asceticism-born, whose element is asceticism. [tapas.]
तम्: √tam (tā́myati, -te [763]; tatā́ma; átamat; tāntá [955a]). become darkened, of the eye; become powerless, deadened, stupefied, numb, or inactive. [orig. mg, prob., ‘be dark,’ see tamas: cf. támisrā, ‘darkness,’ Lat. tenebrae, *temsrae, ‘darkness, ’ Old High Ger. dinstar, ‘dark’; Old High Ger. dëmar, ‘dusk,’ Ger. dämmern, ‘become twilight,’ but not Eng. dim.]
तमस्: támas, n. 	—1. darkness; 	—2. spiritual darkness, infatuation; 	—3. darkness as one of the three pervading qualities of all existence, see guṇa 3. [√tam.]
तमोनिष्ठ: tamo-niṣṭha, a. resting or founded on darkness.
तमोभूत: tamo-bhūta, a. dark, enveloped in darkness.  [lit. ‘become darkness,’ tamas: 1273c.]
तरङ्ग: taraṃ-ga, m. wave; wave as subdivision of a work entitled “ocean,” 5613, cf. 451N. [lit. ‘which goes crossing the water’: taram, grd of √tṛ, 995, cf. 1250a.]
तरंग: taraṃ-ga, m. wave; wave as subdivision of a work entitled “ocean,” 5613, cf. 451N. [lit. ‘which goes crossing the water’: taram, grd of √tṛ, 995, cf. 1250a.]
तरु: taru, m. tree. [prob. a modern form of dā́ru, q. v.]
तरुण: táruṇa, a. young; tender; -ka, n. sprout. [cf. τέρην, ‘tender, fine.’]
तरुतले: taru-tale, under the tree, see tala.
तर्क्: √tark (tarkáyati [10412]; tarkayā́m āsa; tarkayiṣyáti; tarkitá; tarkáyitum; tarkayitvā́; -tárkya). 	—1. think over, 1316; reflect, 1313; 	—2. form an idea of. [orig. mg, ‘turn,’ and so (like Lat. volvere animo), ‘turn over or revolve in one's mind’: cf. tarku, ‘spindle’; τρέπ-ω, Lat. torqueo, ‘turn’; Old High Ger. drāhsil, ‘turner,’ Ger. drechseln, ‘turn.’] + pra, form a conception of.
तर्हि: tárhi, adv. at that time; then; yadi… tarhi, if…then. [pron. root ta, 497, 1103c.]
तल: tala, m. n. 	—1. surface; -tale, at end of cpd, equiv. simply to on, 617, 4617; 	—2. the surface or place under an object, e. g. a tree; -tale, at end of cpd, equiv. simply to under, 341, 438; 	—3. sometimes otiose in cpds, e. g. nabhas-tala, sky-surface, i. e. sky.
तल्प: tálpa, m. couch; bed. [for *star-pa, √stṛ, 12012 end: for mg, see under stṛ.]
तल्पशीवन्: talpa-śī́van, f. -varī, a. lying on beds. [1169. 22.]
तस्मात्: tásmāt, adv. from this (cause), hence; therefore; yad…tasmāt, since…therefore.  [pron. root ta, 1114a.]
तात: tāta, m. used in voc. s., to a father, but generally to a junior or an inferior, my dear. [cf. tata.]
तादीत्ना: tādī́tnā, adv. then. [perhaps instr. (1112d) of *tādītna, and this fr. *tadi-tna, ‘of that time,’ and this fr. *tadi (1245e), correl. of yadi.]
तादृश्: tādṛ́ś, a. such. [see 518: for declension, see dṛ́ś.]
तामस: tāmasa, a. dark; pertaining to darkness or the guṇa called tamas. [támas.]
तारा: tārā, f. star. [form of transition to the a-declension (399) from tṛ́, see under stṛ́.]
तावच्छत: tāvac-chata, f. -ī, a. having or embracing so many hundreds. [tāvant (1249a) + śata.]
तावत्: tā́vant [457], 	—1. adj. so great; so much; so many, 1054; extending so far, 1019; lasting so long, 589; correl. w. yāvant, 1019, 1054; 	—2. tāvat, as adv. so much; so far; to such an extent, 9514; so long; for a while, 191; yāvat…tāvat: as long as…so long, 156, 323, 4018; when…then, 4415; just as…then, 227; tāvat…yāvat, so long…as, 192, 423; 	—3. at once; now, 2420, 346, 5317; 	—3a. w. 1st pers. pres. ind., first, before doing any thing else, at once, 2018, 238, 3811; 	—3b. w. imperative: at once, 2423; tāvat…tatas or paścāt, first …then or afterwards, 2718, 384; 	—4. concessively, iha samaye, tāvat, in this case, one must admit, 4110; 	—5. emphasizing, like eva, what precedes, 304, 257. [pron. root ta, 517.]
तावन्त्: tā́vant [457], 	—1. adj. so great; so much; so many, 1054; extending so far, 1019; lasting so long, 589; correl. w. yāvant, 1019, 1054; 	—2. tāvat, as adv. so much; so far; to such an extent, 9514; so long; for a while, 191; yāvat…tāvat: as long as…so long, 156, 323, 4018; when…then, 4415; just as…then, 227; tāvat…yāvat, so long…as, 192, 423; 	—3. at once; now, 2420, 346, 5317; 	—3a. w. 1st pers. pres. ind., first, before doing any thing else, at once, 2018, 238, 3811; 	—3b. w. imperative: at once, 2423; tāvat…tatas or paścāt, first …then or afterwards, 2718, 384; 	—4. concessively, iha samaye, tāvat, in this case, one must admit, 4110; 	—5. emphasizing, like eva, what precedes, 304, 257. [pron. root ta, 517.]
तिज्: √tij (tejáyati; tejayā́m āsa; tejitá). be sharp. [orig. *stig: cf. στίζω, ‘prick,’ στίγ-μα, ‘prick’; Lat. in-stīgāre, ‘prick on’; Eng. stick, ‘to pierce.’]
तिथि: títhi, m. f. a lunar day (of which there are 15 in a half-lunation).
तिरस्: tirás, 	—1. prep. through; across; 	—2. as adv. crossways, sideways; aside; w. kṛ [1713, 10784], put aside, treat disrespectfully,  scold. [√tṛ, ‘cross’: cf. Lat. trans, ‘across.’]
तिर्यक्त्व: tiryaktva, n. condition of a beast. [tiryak, middle stem of tiryañc, 1249a: 1239.]
तिर्यञ्च्: tiryáñc [409d], 	—1. a. directed across; horizontal; 	—2. as subst. m. n. beast (going horizontally, as opposed to man, who walks upright--ūrdhva); 	—3. acc. s. n. tiryak, as adv. across. [tiras or tir, w. añc, 409d: tir, like tiras, is akin w. √tṛ.]
तिल: tilá, m. 	—1. the sesame plant, Sesamum indicum; 	—2. its seed, which is eaten, and furnishes good oil.
तीर: tīra, n. shore or bank. [prop. ‘place of crossing or going into the water,’ √tṛ.]
तु: √tu (távīti [633]; tūtā́va [7864]). have power; be strong. [orig. ‘swell, grow’: cf. τύ-λη, ‘swelling, lump,’ Corcyraean τῦ-μο-ς, ‘mound’; AS. ϸūma, ‘the big (finger),’ Eng. thumb; further, túm-ra, ‘fat, strong’; Lat. tum-ulus, ‘mound,’ tum-or, ‘swelling.’]

tú, pcl. never at beg. of sentence. 	—1. w. imperative, pray; 	—2. in sooth, 7810; 	—3. but, 812, 2613, 3410, etc.; on the other hand, 204; tu…tu, on the one hand…on the other, 216, 17; so…, …tu, …tu, 603; na tv eva tu, but by no means, 6310, 643; kāmaṃ tu…na tu, see kāmam; kiṃ tu, nevertheless, 395; 	—4. used loosely: as equiv. to ca, 581; often as a mere expletive [1122a4], e. g. 49, 6413b.
tu, pron. root of 2nd pers, see tvad.
तुद्: √tud (tudáti; tutóda; tunná). strike; push. [cf. Τῡδεύς, ‘The Hammer, Martel’; Lat. tundo, tu-tud-i, ‘strike, struck’; Goth. stautan, Ger. stossen, ‘strike.’] + ā, strike at, pick at.
तुर्: √tur (turáti, -te). press onward swiftly [subsidiary form of √tṛ (242) and allied w. √tvar.]
तुर: 1turá, a. 	—1. swift, esp. of horses; -am, as adv. swiftly, in turaṃga; --2. quick, ready, willing, 7817. [√tur.]
तुरङ्ग: turaṃga, m. horse. [‘swiftly going,’ turam + ga, see 1tura: for mg, cf. khaga.]
तुरंग: turaṃga, m. horse. [‘swiftly going,’ turam + ga, see 1tura: for mg, cf. khaga.]
तुल्: √tul (toláyati; tolayā́m āsa; tolayiṣyáti; tolitá; -tólya). --1. raise up; 	—2. esp. raise up a thing so as to find its weight; weigh; 	—3. counterpoise; 	—4. equal. [orig. mg, ‘bear, i. e. hold up’: in the cognates,  the mg ‘bear, i. e. endure’ appears: cf. Lat. tul-i, ‘endured’; Goth. ϸul-an, Eng. thole, ‘endure’; Ger. Ge-dul-d, ‘endurance’;  also ἔ-τλη-ν, ‘bore,’ πολύ-τλᾱ-ς, ‘much enduring’; Lat. lātus, *tlā-tus, ‘borne.’]
तुला: tulā́, f. balance; weight; equality. [√tul: cf. Anglo-Indian tola, about 180 grains troy: cf. τάλαντον, ‘balance, weight.’]
तुल्य: tulya, a. keeping the balance with; equal to; like. [tulā, 1212d 4 end.]
तुल्याकृति: tulyākṛti, a. having like appearance; alike. [ākṛti.]
तुवि: tuví, a. in cpds. mighty; much; many. [√tu, 1155.]
तुविबाध: tuvi-bādhá, a. distressing many (enemies) or besetting (them) sore.
तुष्: √tuṣ (túṣyati, -te; tutóṣa; tuṣṭá; tóṣṭum; -túṣya; toṣáyati). become quiet; be satisfied or pleased; caus. satisfy; gratify. + sam, caus. satisfy.
तूष्णीम्: tūṣṇī́m, adv. silently, in silence. [prob. fr. an obsolete *tūṣṇa, ‘silent,’ √tuṣ, 1111d.]
तृ: √tṛ (tárati, -te; tiráti, -te; tatā́ra, terús [794e]; átārīt; tariṣyáti, -te; tīrṇá; tártum; tīrtvā́; -tī́rya; tāráyati). 	—1. cross over (a water, the sky); 	—2. get across or to the end; get through, escape; survive. [cf. τέρμων, Lat. terminus, ‘boundary’: see √trā and tiras: for treatment of root-vowel,  see 242.] + ava, descend, esp. from heaven to earth; come down, esp. of divine beings who become incarnate as men; alight; betake one's self to; caus. take down or off. + ud, come up out of the water. + abhy-ud, come out of the water unto, cross the water unto, 894. + pra, take to the water; start on. + vi, cross through; traverse.
तृच: tṛcá, m. n. strophe of three stanzas. [tri + ṛc, 243, 1315c.]
तृण: tṛ́ṇa, n. grass. [cf. (θρόνα=) τρόνα, ‘flowers, herbs’; Eng. thorn; Ger. Dorn, ‘thorn.’]
तृतीय: tṛtī́ya, a. third. [fr. tri, through trita, 243, 4874: cf. τρί-τος, Lat. ter-tius, Eng. thir-d, Ger. dri-tte, ‘third.’]
तृद्: √tṛd (tṛṇátti, tṛntté; tatárda, tatṛdé; tṛṇṇá; -tṛ́dya). split; bore; open. + anu, bore after (waters), release, make flow.
तृप्: √1tṛp (tṛ́pyati, -te [761a]; tatárpa; átṛpat; trapsyáti; tṛptá; -tṛ́pya; tarpáyati). be satisfied; become content; --caus. satisfy,  please; nourish. [cf. τέρπω, ‘satisfy, please,’ τρέφω, ‘nourish.’] + ā, become content or glad.
√2tṛp, steal, not actually occurring in vbl forms, but rendered probable by the deriv. tṛpu, ‘thief,’ the cpds asu- and paśu-tṛp, and by the Avestan √tṛf, ‘steal.’
तृष्: √tṛṣ (tṛ́ṣyati; tatárṣa; átṛṣat; tṛṣitá; tarṣáyati). be thirsty. [cf. τέρσ-ομαι, ‘become dry’; Lat. torret, *tors-et, ‘grows dry, scorches’; Eng. noun thirs-t; Ger. dorr-et, ‘grows dry’; also Lat. terra, *ters-a, ‘the dry (land).’]
तेजस्: téjas, n. 	—1. sharpness, edge; 	—2. tip of flame or ray; gleaming splendor, 16; fire; 	—3. (splendor, i. e.) beauty of person, 810ff.; 	—4. (like Eng. fire, i. e.) energy, vigor, power; 	—5. moral or magic power, 1123; influence, dignity, 958; majesty, 16, 24. [√tij: observe that ἀκμή has mgs 1 and 4.]
तेन: téna, adv. in that way, 4717; so; therefore, 187, etc.; yatas or yad or yena…tena, for the reason that…, therefore, 308, 576, 649. [pron. root ta, 1112a: of like derivation and mg is τῷ.]
तोक: toká, n. creation, progeny. [cf. √takṣ and √tvakṣ, and túc.]
तोरण: toraṇa, n. arched portal; arch. [‘passage,’ √tur, subsidiary form of √tṛ, ‘cross, pass.’]
त्य: tyá [499a], pron. that; that well-known (like Lat. ille).
त्यक्तजीवित: tyakta-jīvita, a. having life set aside, risking one's life, brave.
त्यज्: √tyaj (tyájati, -te; tatyā́ja, tatyajé; átyākṣīt; tyakṣyáti, -te; tyaktá; tyáktum; tyaktvā́; -tyájya; tyajyáte; tyājáyati). --1. withdraw from; leave in the lurch; abandon (dove, goat, tree); 	—2. renounce (passions, use of a language); relinquish (exertion); lay aside (a certain form, an earthly body); set aside, i. e. risk (life). [cf. σέβομαι, ‘shrink back from in awe, revere.’] + pari, leave to one's fate (a jackal); abandon; leave (one's party); relinquish or give up (play, food, affairs); parityakta, (abandoned by, i. e.) separated from, 663.
त्रय: trayá, a. triple, threefold, 5713; as n. triad, triplet, τριάς. [tri, 4894.]
त्रस्: √tras (trásati; tatrā́sa, tatrasús, treṣús [794e2]; átrāsīt; trasiṣyáti; trastá). tremble; fear. [cf. τρέω, τρέσ-σε, ‘tremble, trembled’; Lat. terreo, ‘affright’; a-trastas and ἄ-τρεστος, ‘unterrified.’]
त्रसदस्यु: trasádasyu, m. Trasadasyu, a generous prince, the favorite of the gods, and descended from Purukutsa. [Perhaps for trasád-dasyu, ‘affrighting the evil beings,’ see 13094. √tras.]
त्रा: √trā (trā́ti, trā́te [628]; trā́yate [761c]; tatré; átrāsta; trāsyáte; trātá; trā́tum; trātvā́). protect; rescue; rescue from, w. abl. [collateral form of √tṛ (‘get through or across’), w. a caus. mg, ‘bring through or across (trouble).’]
त्रि: trí [482c], num. three. [cf. τρεῖς, τρία, Lat. trēs, tria, Eng. three, Ger. drei, ‘three.’]
त्रिकद्रुक: tríkadruka, m. pl. perhaps designation of certain Soma-vessels, three in number. [cf. trí and kadrū́.]
त्रिकाल: tri-kāla, n. the three times, present, past, and future. [kāla, masc.: 1312.]
त्रिकालज्ञ: trikāla-jña, a. knowing present, past, and future; omniscient.
त्रिदश: tri-daśá [declined like kāma, 330], m. pl. the three times ten, the thirty, a name in round numbers for the 33 deities (12 Adityas,  8 Vasus, 11 Rudras, 2 Aśvins), i. e. the gods. [tri + daśa, 477c: cf. triṃśat.]
त्रिदशेश्वर: tridaśeśvara, m. pl. lords of the gods, i. e. the four chief gods, Indra, Agni, Varuna,  and Yama. [īśvara.]
त्रिदिव: tri-divá, n. the triple or third i. e. highest heaven. [dív, 1315c: 13123.]
त्रिधातु: tri-dhā́tu, a. having three parts, tri-partite,  threefold. [acct, 1300c.]
त्रिपद: tri-pada, f. -ī, a. having (taken) three steps.
त्रिरात्र: tri-rātrá, n. space of three nights, trinoctium.  [rā́tri, 1315b, 13123, 4: cf. the Eng. usage in sen-night, fort-night.]
त्रिविद्या: tri-vidyā, f. the three sciences, i. e. Vedas. [13123.]
त्रिविध: trí-vidha, a. of three sorts, threefold. [vidhā, 1302c 5: acct, 1300c.]
त्रिवृत्: tri-vṛ́t, a. threefold, tri-partite. [‘turning thrice, with three turns.’]
त्रिवेद: tri-veda, in cpds and derivs. the three Vedas. [13123.]
त्रिषवण: tri-ṣavaṇa, a. pertaining to the three Soma-pressings; -am, adv. at morning, noon, and evening. [savana.]
त्रिस्: trís, adv. thrice. [see tri: cf. τρίς, Lat. ter, *ters, ‘thrice’: Eng. thrice is a gen. form, cognate in root only.]
त्रैविद्य: traividya, n. study of the three Vedas. [trividyā.]
त्रैवेदिक: traivedika, a. relating to the three Vedas. [triveda, 1222c 2.]
त्व: tvá, pron. stem of 2d pers., see tvad.
त्वक्ष्: √tvakṣ, work, principally in derivs., and ident. w. takṣ.
त्वत्: tvát, abl. of tva, and used in place of tva in cpds: by Hindus written tvad, q. v. [494.]
त्वत्कृते: tvat-kṛte, for the sake of thee. [1314f, 1130: tvat represents the stem tva, and in gen. relation.]
त्वद्: tvad [491], so-called stem [494] of 2d pers. pron. thou; see tvat. [w. the real root tu, cf. Doric τύ, Lat. tū, AS. ðū, Eng. thou, Ger. du, ‘thou.’]
त्वर्: √tvar (tvárate; tatvaré; tūrṇá [cf. 957b], tvaritá; tvaráyati). hasten; tvarita, having hastened, in haste. [see √√tur, tṛ.]
त्वष्टृ: tváṣṭṛ, m. 	—1. wright, workman, 756; 	—2. Twashtar, the artificer of the gods (703), former of fruit of the womb, giver of growth and long life (8615), father of Saranyū (8512). [√tvakṣ, 221.]
